about: Pad on the phone, Step A (share claude/tinhat-pad/PAD-PHONE/DESIGN.md): one tile per PERSON. Byte-identical in web src/features/calls/persontiles.vectors.json and desktop crates/app/src/testvectors/persontiles.json. personOf(identity, attrs): the server-minted tinhat.person P (a valid mxid) and identity === P + ':' + DEVICE ([A-Za-z0-9_+/-]{1,64}: the server's identity.mjs DEVICE_RE, 0.3.12) with an optional exact '~watch-<16 lowercase hex>'; anything else is nobody's (its own tile). chipOf: personOf ok + tinhat.pad=phone + tinhat.mode=watch + the ~watch- suffix. The mxid localpart: 1-255 UTF-16 code units, none of them ':' or one of JavaScript's \s characters ([\t\n\v\f\r \u00a0\u1680\u2000-\u200a\u2028\u2029\u202f\u205f\u3000\ufeff]: the server's MXID_RE). Fold output fields: members (sorted; [] for one device), pad, muted (all members), othersLive (self tile: one of my other devices' mic is live), alts / altOf (a person's other cameras: one shown, the others kept and hidden), serverMuted (every member) / partlyMuted (some). Step B (12.1.10 / server 0.3.14): the phone's Mic / Camera modes — chipOf also gives 'mic' (tinhat.mode=mic + the '~pad-mic-<16 lowercase hex>' suffix) and 'camera' (tinhat.mode=camera + '~pad-cam-<16 lowercase hex>'); a person's pad = their chips once each in the order watch, mic, camera joined by '+'; a Camera-mode device has no mic (as a watcher); a Pad camera is shown unless the viewer picked another (the lowest such tile id). play: playMicOf(identity, attrs, own) = false only for my OWN other devices (server-vouched). chimes: PersonChimes steps (join / leave / tick with the identities present, me included, and the clock): a join chimes only for a person with no other connection, a leave only for their last one, a Pad connection's last leave waits 5000 ms and their return in that time cancels both. keyAlias: keyAliasBase(identity, attrs) = the '<mxid>:<device>' whose media keys a server-vouched Pad Mic / Camera connection decrypts under (its suffix dropped), else '' (normal, Watch, unvouched, mismatched).

fold.name: a 2-device person (computer + watching phone) = one tile with the chip; nobody else changes
the negative control: no server attribute (an old server, a pre-upgrade session) = separate tiles, no chip
a colon-injection session (pre-upgrade, no attribute) never joins the person it looks like
a camera: the person's camera tile carries the group, the avatar of the other device goes, a share stays its own tile
my own phone watching folds into my self tile (the chip on mine)
two people never merge, even with the same display name; each person's devices merge in identity order
my other device's live mic shows on my self tile (its level counts for my ring)
two cameras of one person: one tile shows one (the lowest tile id), the other is kept and hidden
two cameras: the viewer's own pick is shown instead
a moderator's mute on ONE device of a person: the tile says partly; on every device: muted by a moderator
review r2: a watcher has no mic (it publishes nothing): never 'live on another device', never makes its person unmuted
review r2: my self-view and my other device's camera are ONE person's cameras: my self-view shown, the other behind the switcher
review r2: I picked my other device's camera: it is shown with my tile's fields, my self-view behind the switcher
assembly-045 review: a watcher that joined first never stands for the person (the computer's avatar does), and a watcher never decides 'moderated' (the computer is server-muted = the person is)
Step B: a computer muted by the takeover + its phone in Mic mode, transmitting = one tile, live, chip mic
Step B: a phone in Mic mode that is muted + a muted computer = one tile, muted
Step B: a Camera-mode phone (no mic) never makes the person 'not muted'; its camera is the shown one over the computer's (lower id)
Step B: the viewer's pick of the computer's camera holds over the Pad camera
Step B: a computer + a phone in Mic mode + a tablet in Camera mode = one tile, pad 'mic+camera', the Pad camera shown
Step B: a moderator's mute on the computer only, phone in Camera mode = fully moderated (the camera has nothing to mute)
Step B: a moderator's mute on the computer only, phone in Mic mode not muted = partly moderated, live
Step B: MY phone in Mic mode, transmitting, while my computer is muted by the takeover = my tile says another device is live
Step B: MY phone in Camera mode: its camera is my shown camera over my self-view (my explicit choice), the self-view an alternative
Step B: a forged Mic chip (mode mic on a ~watch identity) = no chip, still the person's (grouped, no mic of its own)

play.name: my phone's mic on my computer: not played
my other computer's mic: not played either
no server attribute (an old server): played (never silenced on the string alone)
a forged person attribute on another account's identity: played
a port user is not the portless user

chimes.name: a new person joins: 1 join chime; their Pad phone joining after: none
a person whose phone joins first (the race): the phone is their first connection = 1 chime, the computer after = none
the Pad phone leaves while the computer stays: no chime
the computer (last normal device) leaves while the phone watches: no chime; then the phone (last) leaves and doesn't come back: 1 leave chime after the grace
a phone alone in the call switches Watch -> Mic -> Camera (leave + rejoin each time): no chime at all
a person's last NORMAL device leaves: a leave chime at once
my own phone joins my call on Pad Mic: no chime (I am present)
negative control: someone else's phone joining is a new person when they have no other connection
without the server attribute (old server): the identity's own mxid decides, the Pad suffix dropped
a held-back leave whose person came back with a normal device (Talk here) = no chimes
a return AFTER the grace (a late timer): both the leave and the arrival chime (owed leave played by the next tick)
